build.description: Runs dotnet build or dotnet publish once over a generated traversal project of every batched project, restoring inside the run, letting MSBuild order the projects, and reporting each project's own result

check.description: Reads the SARIF 2.1 reports a project's compile wrote through ErrorLog and fails on each result at level warning or error that no suppression answers, printed as file(line,col): level id: text

format.description: Runs dotnet format commands in order on one project, or once each over a solution of every batched project
